summary: parse_offset rejected negative zero offsets (-00:00, -0000, and -00), causing Timestamp parsing to return ParseFailure. Removing the guard accepts these offsets as zero while preserving hour/minute bounds. Blocked: the fix adds no tests, existing timestamp parsing tests omit negative zero offsets, and the parsing roundtrip property only produces Z offsets. No detecting upstream test was found at the fixed commit. The reversal regions are unique and restore the exact parent file; no builds or tests were run.
